summary: Validated the new Undo (10s) bulk-delete snackbar + restore endpoint and the Hebrew localization expansion. Backend: 9/9 new pytest cases pass (bulk-restore happy path, RBAC, 404 for unknown / consumed snapshot, snapshot_id returned by bulk-delete, featured-list restoration). Frontend: end-to-end Playwright run — selected 2 seeded properties, clicked Delete selected → snackbar 'bulk-delete-undo-snackbar' appeared with 'Undo' button, clicked Undo, both listings restored (verified via /api/admin/properties GET). Hebrew: nav 'Menu'→'תפריט', carousel pills 'הקודם'/'גלול לעוד', language-toggle aria-label='החלפת שפה', FAQ Back='חזור', i18n keys for paymentSuccess/welcome/cancelBooking all present in he bundle.
code_review_observations: GOOD: bulk-restore correctly skips properties that already exist (idempotent against admin re-creating an id between delete & undo) and deletes the tombstone only after success so a second click correctly 404s.
GOOD: snapshot is created BEFORE the cascade deletes — no race window where the cascade succeeds but the snapshot fails.
GOOD: ListingsTab.bulkDelete branches on whether snapshot_id is present; on 0-deleted (ghost ids) it falls back to a plain toast.success instead of mounting an Undo snackbar — sensible UX.

MINOR: bulk-restore's detached-subleases re-link is a no-op (`pass`) — the code comment explicitly acknowledges this and accepts the trade-off. Subleases survive as standalone listings post-restore. Worth a follow-up: also snapshot `(sublease_id → original_property_id)` map so re-linking on undo is exact.
MINOR: property_tombstones has no TTL index — confirmed by main agent's note. Recommend adding a TTL of e.g. 24h on `deleted_at` so old undo snapshots auto-purge.

MINOR: UndoBulkDeleteSnackbar uses `setInterval(100ms)` for the countdown bar — fine, but on a stale tab it'll continue running until unmount; the toast `duration: 10000` auto-dismiss handles unmount so no leak in practice.
action_items: (OPTIONAL) Add a TTL index on db.property_tombstones.deleted_at (e.g. 24h) so tombstones don't accumulate.
(OPTIONAL) Snapshot the sublease→original_property mapping so undo can re-link detached subleases exactly (currently a documented gap in admin.py:642-649).
critical_code_review_comments: No critical defects. The Undo feature is well-designed: tombstone is captured atomically before cascade, RBAC enforced on both endpoints, 404 semantics correct on missing/consumed snapshots, and the frontend correctly mounts the snackbar via sonner toast.custom with position:bottom-center and duration matching the 10s countdown. Hebrew dictionary has all 734 keys claimed; spot-checked 8 keys across nav/home/faq/paymentSuccess/welcome/cancelBooking — all render.

Token must be placed in sessionStorage (NOT localStorage) for the React app to pick it up — App.js uses sessionStorage.getItem('token') in its useState initializer.
seed_data_creation: 9 throwaway properties created via POST /api/properties as owner@test.com (titles TEST_bulk_restore_*, TEST_undo_v3_*), all cleaned up via the bulk-delete endpoint at end of each test. Canonical fixtures 4f5680df-... / 86c6e09c-... never touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To regress: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_admin_bulk_restore_http.py /app/backend/tests/test_admin_bulk_delete_http.py /app/backend/tests/test_admin_bulk_delete.py -v`. Important gotcha for FE tests: the app stores the auth token in sessionStorage('token'), NOT localStorage. Setting localStorage will silently fail — App.js reads sessionStorage.getItem('token') in its useState initializer and only fetches /auth/me when that's present. The Listings tab testid is 'admin-tab-listings' under /admin (not /admin/dashboard). Hebrew language preference is stored in localStorage('i18nextLng')='he' — reload required for it to take effect. PaymentSuccess (/payment/success) is auth-gated, so visiting unauth shows a Hebrew login page rather than the success H1; the H1 string itself is in i18n.js line 1449 and only renders after a real payment.
rca of the issue: N/A — both new features (Undo snackbar + restore endpoint, Hebrew localization pass) work as designed end-to-end.
